title: A Taxonomy and Taxonomy-Guided Benchmark Reduction for Spreadsheet Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2611.21452v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spreadsheets let millions of end users without programming training do computational work, and teams are increasingly building AI agents to help them. Evaluating each candidate agent configuration across many tasks is costly. Benchmark reduction can lower this cost by selecting a small subset of tasks whose outcomes predict full-benchmark scores, but selecting tasks only for predictive accuracy can leave whole categories of spreadsheet work untested. We contribute a taxonomy of spreadsheet tasks, grounded in a review of benchmarks and refined with the Excel Agent product team at Microsoft, and a benchmark-reduction method that favors taxonomic diversity among similarly predictive choices. On benchmark logs from Microsoft, taxonomy-guided selection broadens coverage at little or no cost in predictive accuracy and often improves prediction on configurations excluded from selection. translated_title: 一种电子表格任务分类法及基于分类法引导的基准测试缩减方法
translated_abstract: 电子表格让数百万没有接受过编程训练的最终用户能够完成计算工作，越来越多的团队正在构建 AI 智能体来帮助他们。在众多任务上评估每个候选智能体配置的成本高昂。基准测试缩减可以通过选择一小组任务（其结果能够预测完整基准测试的得分）来降低这一成本，但仅以预测准确性为标准来选择任务，可能会使整个类别的电子表格工作得不到测试。我们贡献了一个电子表格任务分类法，该分类法基于对基准测试的审查，并与微软的 Excel Agent 产品团队共同完善；同时我们提出了一种基准测试缩减方法，该方法在预测能力相近的选择中优先考虑分类多样性。在微软的基准测试日志上，分类法引导的任务选择在几乎不损失甚至不损失预测准确性的情况下扩大了覆盖范围，并且通常能提升对未纳入选择集的配置的预测效果。因此，更广的覆盖范围可以支持而非损害（预测质量）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个电子表格任务分类法，并据此设计了在预测能力相近时优先保证分类多样性的基准测试缩减方法，从而在几乎不损失预测准确性的前提下显著扩大任务覆盖范围。
en_tdlr: This paper contributes a taxonomy of spreadsheet tasks and a taxonomy-guided benchmark reduction method that favors taxonomic diversity among similarly predictive choices, broadening task coverage with little or no cost to predictive accuracy.
